controlPoints.name: ground-1
controlPoints.note: Rear ground corner obscured by raised fence; estimated below fence top, not the top of railing.

observations: Both public shop doors lie on the visible street-facing frontage, with brick forecourt connections.
Trees have soil/grass pools, low edging and short fences; roofs have vents rather than trees.
Ground far corners/roof/facade proportions drift from the exact geometric guide. Only the road-facing edge determines scale and translation; rear residuals are reported and not removed by distortion.
Nominal guide heights and setbacks are layout candidates, not precision measurements of the painted walls.

controlPoints.name: ground-0
controlPoints.note: Upper street-end ground corner hidden under roof/fence; estimated along visible frontage direction using guide length.

observations: Visible walls are residential rear/side facades, without false public doors or shop awnings. Public frontage and doors remain hidden on the far street side.
Visible rear garden has soil/grass, low stone edging/fence, trees, bench and bicycle area; no rooftop trees.
Front upper ground point is inferred, not directly seen. Rear ground rectangle and building proportions differ locally from guide; hidden edge registration remains approximate.
The asset is uniformly scaled and translated only. Do not describe all four guide corners or painted heights as exactly calibrated.
New native higher view with more visible helmet/box top; travel silhouette points NE, but drawn wheel axis is about34 degrees rather than exact road28.5 degrees. No plane rotation used.
Ground-contact midpoint is manually inferred from the two wheel bases; no baked ground background/shadow.
Native opposite view, round front headlight lower-left, box upper-right, high view with helmet and box top visible; not a flipped NE image.
Rear wheel contact partially hidden by exhaust/box, so rear contact and midpoint are manual candidates. Minor independently painted identity/proportion and heading differences remain.
